To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a new VAD method based on a likelihood ratio test that improves robustness in speech detection and the performance of robust speech recognition systems.
a jointly Gaussian probability distribution function (PDF) is used for a pair of observations to improve speech detection robustness and speech recognition accuracy in noisy environments.
we propose a new voice activity detection algorithm based on the likelihood ratio test that is robust to noise and can be used in a speech recognition system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, development and implementation of new methods for the detection of the presence of speech in a noisy environment.
the detection of speech in noisy environments.
the development of a robust VAD for improving the performance of speech processing algorithms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed VAD algorithm provides the best trade-off between speech detection accuracy and speech/non-speech classification delay.
the proposed method is an efficient and accurate VAD for improving speech recognition in noisy environments.
the proposed algorithm is an excellent alternative for VAD in speech recognition systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a new VAD algorithm for improving speech detection in noise robustness in noisy environment and the performance of automatic speech recognition system.
the proposed VAD method is able to provide a better speech detection accuracy in comparison with other VADs.
the proposed algorithm is able to improve the performance of speech processing systems by means of a robust and computationally efficient speech/non-speech detector.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed VAD method is robust to noise and can be easily implemented.

, in a scenario of multiple and correlated observations, the proposed LRT detector outperforms the standard likelihood ratio test (LR), the G.729 and the AMR algorithms in terms of detection performance and, in the case of the AFE, the improvement is also noticeable.

, by exploiting a jointly Gaussian Probability Distribution Function (PDF) in the definition of the decision rule, the proposed VAD is robust to a wide range of noise types and can improve the performance of a speech recognition system in noisy environments.
